boosters.wildcard: Unlimited transfers before a deadline (not available in Round 1 or before Round of 32)
boosters.12th_man: All bench players auto-subbed into XI for that round
boosters.maximum_captain: Highest-scoring player in your XI automatically becomes captain (double points)
boosters.qualification_booster: +2 points for each starting XI player that advances to the next knockout round (up to +22)
boosters.mystery_booster: Revealed when Round 3 locks and Round of 32 opens
